pipeline.modality: First-in-class fully synthetic enantiomeric neurosteroid; intranasal spray-dry powder delivery
pipeline.target: Neuroprotective / anti-inflammatory (enantiomer of progesterone-related neurosteroid; does not activate classical progesterone receptor)

indications.trial_name: Phase IIa pilot study of ONP-002 in adults with mTBI
indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2a; safety, tolerability, PK and PD endpoints; sites in Australia (Mackay Base Hospital, Alfred Hospital).
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (per company press releases April-May 2026: second site activated; 8 doses administered; readout projected before year-end 2026). ctgov record still shows NOT_YET_RECRUITING.
key_milestones: Phase IIa data readout projected before year-end 2026.
Planned IND submission to FDA targeting Dec 31, 2026 to support a US Phase IIb trial.

excluded_preclinical: Additional CNS platform assets — exploring acquisitions per March 2026 press release; no IND filed.
excluded_legacy_terminated: AG013 (NCT03234465) Phase 2 oral mucositis — TERMINATED (legacy mucosal-immune asset).
